As a result of the strong El Niño, it has been a notably quiet Atlantic hurricane season. articles.title: AI boom and trade resilience to Middle East crisis lift outlook, but gains to be uneven

WTO economists have therefore raised the forecast for merchandise trade growth in 2026 while lowering the outlook for services trade.

articles.title: General Council addresses WTO reform, ministerial follow-ups, ongoing negotiations
articles.description: WTO members meeting at the General Council on 5-6 October addressed issues related to the ongoing discussions on WTO reform, follow-up to outcomes of past ministerial conferences, and the state of ongoing negotiations on various topics. articles.titleJa: 総理事会、WTO改革、閣僚会議のフォローアップ、進行中の交渉について議論

articles.title: Co-sponsors of sustainability initiative advance work plan towards MC15

Several members reported on MSME initiatives in formal WTO committees.

articles.title: Director-General cites concerns with pace of negotiations as chairs report on state of play

articles.title: Co-sponsors of Plastics Dialogue hold first round of technical discussions following MC14
